messages.subject: Question re resource - generator
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to model a complex system with Simmer in which there is a long queue and a limited resource. I need for the customers in the queue to each have a priority as well as certain intrinsic properties that make the resource compatible to them or not. For example, lots of people who are in line for a concert ticket but when they get to the counter they find out they can't afford the tickets and go back into the queue until cheaper tickets are available. Is there any way to assign specific properties to the generator that can be assessed by the resource?

Thanks very much in advance!!!

Evan

messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Question re resource - generator
parts:
Hi Evan,

Arrivals may roll back based on the value of an attribute:

library(simmer)

env <- simmer()

set_type <- function(type)
trajectory() %>%
set_attribute("type", type) %>%
join(counter)

counter <- trajectory() %>%
log_("arriving") %>%
seize("counter", 1) %>%
branch(
function() get_attribute(env, "type") < 2, continue=F,
# go back to the queue
trajectory() %>%
release("counter", 1) %>%
timeout(1) %>%
rollback(5, times=2) %>%
log_("leaving (branch)")
) %>%
log_("purchasing") %>%
timeout(5) %>%
release("counter", 1) %>%
log_("leaving")

env %>%
add_resource("counter") %>%
add_generator("one", set_type(1), at(0)) %>%
add_generator("another", set_type(2), at(0)) %>%
run(10)

Or they may roll back based on the name of the generator:

library(simmer)

env <- simmer()

counter <- trajectory() %>%
log_("arriving") %>%
seize("counter", 1) %>%
branch(
function() grepl("one", get_name(env)), continue=F,
# go back to the queue
trajectory() %>%
release("counter", 1) %>%
timeout(1) %>%
rollback(5, times=2) %>%
log_("leaving (branch)")
) %>%
log_("purchasing") %>%
timeout(5) %>%
release("counter", 1) %>%
log_("leaving")

env %>%
add_resource("counter") %>%
add_generator("one", counter, at(0)) %>%
add_generator("another", counter, at(0)) %>%
run(10)

The latter is certainly simpler, but the name of a generator is
static, while attributes may change during the simulation.

Regards,
Iñaki
